name: hud_recti_calc_outcode
description: HudRectI::CalcOutcode computes the recovered Cohen-Sutherland-style outcode bits for a point against a HUD rectangle.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x416240 has no direct callees and computes left=1, right=2, top=8, and the recovered bottom bit=4 comparison against point->x rather than point->y; HLIL has expected x87 flag-word verbosity.
The native rect-clip helper smoke verifies inside, left/top, right, y-only-below, and x-driven bottom-bit cases.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x416240 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
